name: @aegis-cc/subscriptions
description: Promoted from Platform-Services/Subscriptions to a first-class Platform Service: subscription plans, billing, usage/quota tracking, and entitlement policy (per-tier device caps, channel access). Nearly every other service either checks entitlements against it (device enrollment, channel access) or records consumption against it (AI Chat's token usage) -- the same cross-cutting-infrastructure role Authentication plays for identity, not an independent feature domain like Compliance or Tickets.
